{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "SQLite has offered WAL mode since version 3.7.0",
      "claim_text": "SQLite has offered WAL mode since version 3.7.0.",
      "kind": "version",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": {"kind": "version", "left": "3.7.0", "op": ">=", "right": "3.7.0"},
      "reasoning": "Passage states WAL available beginning with version 3.7.0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "writers and readers can run at the same time",
      "claim_text": "In WAL mode, writers and readers can run at the same time.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P3.S1."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "there can only be one writer at a time",
      "claim_text": "In WAL mode, there can only be one writer at a time.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P3.S2."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "A checkpoint runs automatically once the WAL file reaches 1000 pages",
      "claim_text": "By default, a checkpoint runs automatically once the WAL file reaches 1000 pages.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states default automatic checkpoint at 1000 pages."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "the WAL file is normally named after the database file with a \"-wal\" suffix",
      "claim_text": "The WAL file is normally named after the database file with a \"-wal\" suffix.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P4.S1."
    }
  ]
}
